name: Weekly planner
blurb: Every Monday morning a researcher gathers your open tasks and notes, and a writer turns them into a short plan for the week.

crew.name: Weekly planner
crew.brief: A short plan for the week: the three things that matter most, what is waiting on someone, and what can wait.

members.task: Gather the open tasks, notes and dates for this week from the workspace
Write a short plan for the week from what the researcher gathered
